# Cedar Ridge Dental — full content mirror

> Family and cosmetic dentist in Portland, OR.

## Home
Cedar Ridge Dental is a family and cosmetic dental practice in Portland, Oregon, accepting
new patients and most PPO insurance plans. Services: preventive cleanings, tooth-colored
fillings, dental implants, clear aligners, cosmetic whitening, and same-day emergency care.

- Phone: +1 (503) 555-0142
- Address: 1200 Cedar Road, Portland, OR 97201
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00

## About
Cedar Ridge Dental has cared for Portland families for more than fifteen years. Two dentists
and three hygienists, licensed in Oregon, focused on preventive and restorative care.
